goal.title: 4 · Definitions sit on shelves
goal.text:
The main plate already says 9 sq >, and nothing defines sq yet.

On the shelf below, build one column: a box that squares the top value, then the word as a quote, then ><. Inside the box: _a@ moves the top value into _a, _a~ _a~ * multiplies it by itself, =~ puts the product back.

Shelves run before the main plate, and a lower shelf is an older definition.
